headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Swerve Strickland vs. Claudio Castagnoli went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.08 ? a real highlight of the night. In a surprise open challenge on his first Collision as champion, Strickland survived a 21-minute war and hit the House Call to retain the AEW World Title against Castagnoli, the two shaking hands afterward.
